verdicts.evidence: After Zalens's 2026-08-11 comment, the author re-signed the change with an SSH key. `git cat-file commit ab035b78e` and `git cat-file commit 7cf1f574f` (HEAD) both contain a `gpgsig -----BEGIN SSH SIGNATURE-----` header. The author's 2026-08-12 comments confirm that both commits show as Verified. Git's local `%G?` check reads `N` only because no allowed-signers file is configured here, so the commit was already signed at the reviewed commit.
